criteria-objective.reason: RESTORED 2026-08-27 after the two defective criteria were amended and the full set of thirty-two was judged. Run 1 (ACC-0001..ACC-0012, CMP-0011) is unchanged and stands as attested on 2026-08-22, AC-9 included with its proxies named. Run 2 (ACC-0013..ACC-0035, CMP-0012..CMP-0020) is now judged objective as a set. ⚠️ ACC-0014 WAS UNFALSIFIABLE, NOT MERELY IMPRECISE. It asked that a displayed total equal the number of entries rendered, and the project view renders TOTALS rather than entries — so it compared a number with itself and would have passed on an implementation that printed a constant. Amended to an INDEPENDENT ORACLE: a fixture of known composition, computed outside the application, which is what makes it a test rather than a tautology. ⚠️ ACC-0020 HAD A NUMBER WITHOUT A TEST. Now pinned: the reference environment recorded alongside the result, a timing boundary from the read to completed markup measured server-side, ten discarded warm-up requests, fifty measured serial requests, and per-request verification that compilation actually occurred — a run in which any measured request did not compile is VOID, not a pass. That last clause is load-bearing: the easiest way to hit the budget is to cache the compiled document, which would report excellent numbers while measuring nothing and would violate DEC-0020's request-time requirement at the same time. ⚠️ WHAT THIS ATTESTATION DOES NOT SAY. Every run-2 criterion is `not-evaluated`, because nothing is built. This stage defines the tests; it makes no claim that any component passes them. That distinction is the whole of §2, and it is why `implementedBy` staying absent on CMP-0012..CMP-0020 is a feature rather than an omission. ⚠️ THE 300 ms IS A TARGET, NOT A MEASUREMENT, and it is approved as one. If the first valid run misses it by a wide margin, DEC-0020's third obligation applies: plain markdown for stage documents, not a larger number. ⚠️ REGRESSES AGAIN whenever criteria are authored for a component and not judged against this criterion — which is exactly how it regressed today. That is a normal consequence of the stage running again, not a defect in the stage.
